composio.note: Gusto is in Composio's bring-your-own-OAuth-app list. Create the auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Gusto app, so you must register your own app with Gusto and pass its client ID and secret to Composio.
reasons: No Composio-managed OAuth app exists for Gusto
Production access is only issued to your own approved app
Own app gives dedicated quota and your branding

scenarios.label: Production app for outside customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects real Gusto customer companies in production, directly or via an approved Unified API partner.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; security documentation may take longer to gather

waiting.estimate: 1-2 weeks for pre-approval, then Security Review of unknown length
waiting.basis: c9 (pre-approval review time); no end-to-end timeline published

scenarios.approval: Production Pre-Approval by the Partnerships team, then a Security Review before production keys are issued.

prerequisites.title: Security documentation ready
prerequisites.detail: Prepare audits (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS), penetration test reports, policies and security and incident contacts. Without a formal audit, provide detailed security program information.

prerequisites.title: Track record serving small businesses
prerequisites.detail: Early-stage products still establishing a track record serving small businesses are not currently supported.

steps.title: Create sandbox app in Gusto developer portal
steps.detail: Register the app and get sandbox client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret; use the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists for the gusto toolkit.

steps.title: Draft Production Pre-Approval answers
steps.detail: Draft use case and scope justification and assemble the security document checklist.
steps.done_when: Draft application is ready for review.

steps.title: Submit Production Pre-Approval
steps.detail: Submit company, legal and security details and contacts.

steps.title: Wait for Partnerships review
steps.detail: Review takes about 1-2 weeks. Respond quickly to any requests, as the Security Review is on hold until you do.
steps.done_when: Approval received and Security Review starts.

steps.title: Complete Security Review
steps.detail: Mostly uses your application information; extra information may be requested. Gusto emails next steps when done.
steps.done_when: Gusto emails next steps for production.

traps.title: The Gusto API rate limit is 200 requests per
traps.detail: The Gusto API rate limit is 200 requests per minute per OAuth grant (access token), with 429 responses beyond that; the page does not say it differs for unreviewed apps.

traps.title: Approval is not a formality
traps.detail: Production access is gated and not all applications are approved. Building before approval is at your own risk.

traps.title: Security Review pauses on unanswered requests
traps.detail: Missing a request from Gusto puts the review on hold.

traps.title: Scopes are fixed at production
traps.detail: Calls outside the scopes assigned during review are rejected in production.

blockers.symptom: Application not approved or early-stage product unsupported
blockers.what_it_means: Gusto refuses products without a small-business track record or that fail review.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Gusto partnerships and reapply when ready.

open_questions: How long does the Security Review take end to end? Ask Gusto partnerships after pre-approval.
Does Gusto verify redirect-URI domains? Not found; check in the developer portal.
Do your end users need a company admin to accept terms? Embedded Payroll docs state a company admin must accept Terms of Service; confirm whether this applies to your integration type with Gusto.

To refresh a token, send a POST request to the [/oauth/token](https://docs.gusto.com/embedded-payroll/reference/oauth-access-token)  endpoint with:

* `client_id` and `client_secret` from your [application](https://dev.gusto.com/applications)
* `refresh_token`

```curl
curl --location --request POST 'https://api.gusto-demo.com/oauth/token' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
  "client_id": "{{client_id}}",
  "client_secret": "{{client_secret}}",
  "refresh_token": "T0jHy4Oc3FWi7hDPEMPdpbGiLpB0rWeb1ZJOJVB36oU",
  "grant_type": "refresh_token"
}'
```

You’ll receive a new access and refresh token:

```json
{
  "access_token": "737HdeXfIqgx-NfaUFRuhV7JDe6ns6ptanJSMuQzjlc",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 7200,
  "refresh_token": "iEjL96L9Pndwmi-xVX3Q-xbrvvhnjHYGX87sopgGJ8E"
}
```

When you use the new access token in a Gusto API call, your previous refresh token will be revoked.
